h2: Blocked Drains & Toilets Canggu – Chemical-Free Drain Clearing
intro: Dealing with blocked drains & toilets in Canggu? The culprit is often the ground itself—former rice paddies sit on a high water table that overloads septic systems, while quickly built villas sometimes carry poorly sloped drain lines. We clear the blockage mechanically with a drain snake, skipping the harsh chemicals that corrode pipes and destroy the bacteria your tank needs.

sections.h3: Why Canggu's Ground Makes Blockages More Likely
sections.text: In Berawa and Batu Bolong, many villas went up within a single or two seasons, and drainage was frequently an afterthought. Add the saturated soil left by old paddy fields, and your septic tank fills faster than its design assumed. Once the rainy season peaks, low-lying streets near Echo Beach flood, garden runoff finds every gap, and a drain that was already sluggish turns into a full backup. That trio—tight build timelines, high groundwater, seasonal flooding—drives most of our call-outs here.

A toilet that won't flush, a shower floor that gurgles but never empties, a kitchen sink draining at a crawl, or sewage backing up through the lowest fixture in the house—these four jobs come to us weekly across Pererenan and Babakan. A flexible drain snake pulls out hair, grease, mineral scale or whatever is wedged in the pipe. No pour-and-pray chemical bombs; those eat through PVC joints and kill the anaerobic bacteria keeping your septic system alive. You get a clear line and a tank that still works.

sections.h3: Sending Photos on WhatsApp for a Quote
sections.text: Snap two or three photos before we arrive: the affected fixture, any standing water, and the access point where the drain meets the wall or floor. Send them to our WhatsApp number with your neighbourhood name and a one-line description—'toilet won't flush in Berawa,' 'shower gurgling since Tuesday.' That tells us whether it's a simple trap clog or something deeper in the sewer run, and we reply with a straightforward quote based on what the job actually needs. No obligation from there.

sections.h3: Keeping Drains Clear Through Rainy Season
sections.text: A few small habits save real trouble here. Never pour cooking oil or coffee grounds down the sink—they solidify inside warm pipes within days. Keep a mesh strainer over every shower drain; leaves drifting from surrounding fields plus rotating guests build up fast. Before October rains peak, check that your pump room stays dry and the pool overflow pipe isn't kinked. And if you catch a faint sewage smell near a floor drain after heavy rain, message us early rather than waiting for a full backup.

faq.q: Will chemical drain cleaners damage my septic tank?
faq.a: Yes—caustic products kill the anaerobic bacteria that break down waste, so the tank stops digesting solids and overflows sooner. We avoid all of that by clearing blockages mechanically instead.

faq.q: How do I tell if it's a local clog or a sewer-line problem?
faq.a: If only one fixture is slow, it's usually a trap or branch-pipe issue. When two or more fixtures back up at once, or you see water rising in the lowest drain while others run fine, the main sewer line is likely blocked—send us photos on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before visiting.

faq.q: Do you cover quieter areas like Pererenan and Babakan, not just Berawa?
faq.a: Absolutely. We work across all of Canggu—Berawa, Batu Bolong, Echo Beach, Pererenan, Babakan, Padonan—and travel time to those inner-village roads doesn't change how we quote; pricing depends on the job itself, which we size from your photos.
